name: interior-style-board
description: Turn a style brief into a material and budget board.

interface.longDescription: Turn a style brief into a material and budget board. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Allocate a color palette; Compare materials with your style brief; Allocate room purchases. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me allocate a color palette.
Help me compare materials with your style brief.

prompts: Help me allocate a color palette.
Help me compare materials with your style brief.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Room Palette: Style Boards workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Allocate a color palette. Reproducible inputs: {"total_area_m2":40,"colors":[{"name":"Warm white","percent":60},{"name":"Oak","percent":30},{"name":"Charcoal","percent":10}]}
positive.prompt: Help me allocate a color palette with these supplied values: {"total_area_m2":40,"colors":[{"name":"Warm white","percent":60},{"name":"Oak","percent":30},{"name":"Charcoal","percent":10}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses interior_style_board_palette_allocation with the supplied inputs. Returns {"palette":[{"name":"Warm white","percent":60,"area_m2":24},{"name":"Oak","percent":30,"area_m2":12},{"name":"Charcoal","percent":10,"area_m2":4}]}. Shows the actual palette result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare materials with your style brief. Reproducible inputs: {"desired_materials":["oak","linen"],"desired_colors":["cream","natural"],"pieces":[{"name":"Chair","material":"oak","color":"natural","price":220},{"name":"Sofa","material":"velvet","color":"blue","price":800}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare materials with your style brief with these supplied values: {"desired_materials":["oak","linen"],"desired_colors":["cream","natural"],"pieces":[{"name":"Chair","material":"oak","color":"natural","price":220},{"name":"Sofa","material":"velvet","color":"blue","price":800}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses interior_style_board_style_match with the supplied inputs. Returns {"pieces":[{"name":"Chair","material":"oak","color":"natural","price":220,"material_match":true,"color_match":true},{"name":"Sofa","material":"velvet","color":"blue","price":800,"material_match":false,"color_match":false}],"note":"Matches your supplied brief; style labels are not inferred from photographs."}. Shows the actual swatches result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.prompt: Help me allocate room purchases with these supplied values: {"budget":2000,"contingency_pct":10,"purchases":[{"name":"Chair","price":250,"quantity":2},{"name":"Rug","price":300,"quantity":1}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses interior_style_board_room_budget with the supplied inputs. Returns {"subtotal":800,"reserve":200,"available_after_reserve":1800,"remaining":1000,"purchases":[{"name":"Chair","price":250,"quantity":2},{"name":"Rug","price":300,"quantity":1}]}. Shows the actual budget result. Does not fabricate external data.
